summary: 昆虫群体能将不完整的个体判断汇集起来选巢或找庇护所。蜜蜂的独立核查、机器同伴对蟑螂的影响和蚂蚁搬家的分工说明，作出选择后还要让其他成员跟随。

paragraphs.brief: 多数决策与陪审团定理
sentences: It has long been held that decisions made collectively by large groups of people are more likely to turn out to be accurate than decisions made by individuals.
长期以来人们一直认为，由大批人集体作出的决定比个人作出的决定更可能准确。
The idea goes back to the ‘jury theorem’ of Nicolas de Condorcet, an 18th-century French philosopher who was one of the first to apply mathematics to the social sciences.
这个想法可追溯到18世纪法国哲学家尼古拉·德·孔多塞的“陪审团定理”，他是最早把数学用于社会科学的人之一。
Condorcet’s theory describes collective decisions, outlining how democratic decisions tend to outperform dictatorial ones.
Condorcet的理论描述了集体决定，概述了民主决定如何往往优于独裁决定。
If, for example, each member of a jury has only partial information, the majority decision is more likely to be correct than a decision arrived at by a single juror.
例如，如果陪审团每个成员只有部分信息，多数人的决定比单一陪审员作出的决定更有可能正确。
Moreover, the probability of a correct decision increases with the size of the jury.
此外，随着陪审团人数的增加，作出正确裁决的可能性也随之增加。
paragraphs.gist: 孔多塞的陪审团定理说明，在各成员所知有限的条件下，多数意见仍可能比单人判断准确，而且人数增加会提高判断正确的概率。

sentences: Now it is becoming clear that group decisions are also extremely valuable for the success of social animals, such as ants, bees, birds and dolphins.
研究逐渐表明，集体决策对蚂蚁、蜜蜂、鸟类和海豚等群居动物的生存发展也很有价值。
Bees make collective decisions, and they do it rather well, according to Christian List of the London School of Economics, who has studied group decision-making in humans and animals.
伦敦政治经济学院的克里斯蒂安·利斯特研究人类和动物的群体决策。他指出，蜜蜂不仅会集体作决定，而且做得相当好。
Researchers led by Dr List looked at colonies once the original colony reached a certain size.
利斯特博士带领的团队研究了蜂群达到一定规模之后的情况。
The queen goes off with about two-thirds of the worker bees to live in a new home or nest, leaving a daughter queen in the old nest with the remaining workers.
蜂王带着约三分之二的工蜂去找新家，留下一只新蜂王和其余工蜂守在旧巢。

Among the bees that depart are some that have searched for and found some new nest sites, and reported back using a characteristic body movement known as a ‘waggle dance’ to indicate to the other bees the suitable places they have located.
离开的蜜蜂中，有些已找到可能的新巢址，并通过特有的身体动作“摇摆舞”向同伴指示合适地点的位置。
The longer the dance, the better the site.
舞跳得越久，巢址就越好。
After a while, other bees start to visit the sites signalled by their companions to see for themselves and, on their return, also perform more waggle dances.
过一阵子，其他蜜蜂会到同伴指示的地点亲自察看，回来后也会跳起摇摆舞。
The process eventually leads to a consensus on the best site and the breakaway swarm migrates.
最终，蜂群就最佳巢址达成共识，分出的蜂群随即迁去。
The decision is remarkably reliable, with the bees choosing the best site even when there are only small differences between alternative sites.
这个决定十分可靠，即使备选地点只有细微差别，蜜蜂也能选中最好的。
paragraphs.gist: 蜜蜂分群时以摇摆舞传达巢址质量，同伴再实地察看并传递信息，即使候选地点差异细微，蜂群也往往能选到最佳位置。

sentences: But exactly how do bees reach such a robust consensus?
蜜蜂究竟是怎样达成如此可靠的共识的？
To find out, Dr List and his colleagues used a computer-generated model of the decision-making process.
为弄清这一点，利斯特博士和同事用计算机模拟了蜂群的决策过程。

By experimenting with it, they found that, when bees in the model were very good at finding nesting sites but did not share their information, this dramatically slowed down the migration, leaving the swarm homeless and vulnerable.
模拟实验表明，蜜蜂即使很会寻找巢址，如果不共享发现，迁移速度就会大大减慢，使整个蜂群无家可归、容易受害。
Conversely, bees in the model blindly followed the waggle dances of others without first checking.
另一种极端是，模型中的蜜蜂盲从同伴的摇摆舞，并不亲自核实。

The researchers concluded that the ability of bees to identify successfully and quickly the best site depends on both the bees’ interdependence in communicating the whereabouts of the best site, and their independence in confirming this information for themselves.
研究者得出结论，蜜蜂要迅速找出最佳地点，既要靠同伴分享位置，也要能独立核实这些信息。
paragraphs.gist: 计算机模型表明，单靠独自搜索会延误迁移，盲从舞蹈也不足以选好巢址；分享线索与独立核实相配合才又快又可靠。

paragraphs.brief: 机器蟑螂改变群体选择
sentences: Another situation in which collective decisions are taken occurs when animals are either isolated from crucial sources of information or dominated by other members of the group.
群体决策还有另外的情形：动物可能接触不到关键信息来源，或者受到群内其他成员的支配。
Jose Halloy of the Free University of Brussels in Belgium used robotic cockroaches to subvert the behaviour of living cockroaches and control their decision-making process.
比利时布鲁塞尔自由大学的何塞·阿洛伊利用机器蟑螂干预真蟑螂的行为，进而影响它们的决策。
In his experiment, the artificial bugs were introduced to the live ones and soon became sufficiently socially integrated that they were perceived by the real cockroaches as equals.
实验中，机器蟑螂被放进真蟑螂中间，很快就融入群体，真蟑螂甚至把它们当作同伴。

By manipulating the robots, which were in the minority, Halloy was able to persuade the living cockroaches to choose an inappropriate shelter—even one which they had rejected before being infiltrated by the robots.
阿洛伊操控数量占少数的机器蟑螂，就能诱使真蟑螂选择不合适的藏身处，甚至是它们之前拒绝过的地方。
paragraphs.gist: 少数机器蟑螂混入真蟑螂群并获接纳后，研究者通过操控它们，甚至能让群体改选此前已遭拒绝的不合适庇护所。

paragraphs.brief: 蚁群紧急迁巢的两项任务
sentences: The way insects put into effect collective decisions can be complex and as important as the decisions themselves.
昆虫实施集体决定的方式可能与决定本身一样复杂和重要。
At the University of Bristol, in the UK, Nigel Franks and his colleagues studied how a species of ant establishes a new nest.
英国布里斯托大学的奈杰尔·弗兰克斯和同事研究了一种蚂蚁如何建立新巢。
Franks and his associates reported how the insects reduce the problems associated with making a necessarily swift choice.
弗兰克斯和同事报告了这些昆虫如何减少必须迅速作决定时遇到的困难。
If the ants’ existing nest becomes suddenly threatened, the insects choose certain ants to act as scouts to find a new nest.
当现有蚁巢突然受到威胁，一些蚂蚁会被选为侦察蚁去寻找新巢址。
How quickly they accomplish the transfer to a new home depends not only on how soon the best available site is found, but also on how quickly the migration there can be achieved.
蚁群多久能搬完家，既取决于多快能找到最佳巢址，也取决于它们能多快完成迁移。
paragraphs.gist: 蚁巢突然遇险时，侦察蚁须尽快找到新巢，整群撤离的速度还取决于它们能否迅速组织其他成员搬迁。

paragraphs.brief: 熟悉路线者加快整体搬迁
sentences: Once the suitable new nest is identified, the chosen ants begin to lead others, which have made it to the new site or which may simply be in the vicinity, back to the original threatened nest.
找到合适的新巢后，先前被选中的蚂蚁会带领已到新巢或恰在附近的蚂蚁，回到受威胁的旧巢。

In this way, those ants which are familiar with the route can help transport, for example, the queen and young ants to the new site, and simultaneously show the way to those ants which have been left behind to guard the old nest.
熟悉路线的蚂蚁就能协助把蚁后、幼蚁等转移到新址，同时给留守旧巢的蚂蚁带路。
In this way, moving processes are accomplished faster and more efficiently.
这样，整个蚁群搬家更快，效率也更高。
Thus the dynamics of collective decision-making are closely related to the efficient implementation of those decisions.
可见，群体作决策的方式与决策能否有效执行密切相关。
How this might apply to choices that humans make is, as yet, unclear.
这如何适用于人类作出的选择，现在还不清楚。

But it does suggest, even for humans, the importance of recruiting dynamic leaders to a cause, because the most important thing about collective decision-making, as shown by these insect experiments, is to get others to follow.
不过，这些实验提示我们，即使对人类来说，吸引富有号召力的领导者投身某项事业也很重要，因为集体决策最关键的一点就是能让其他成员跟上。
paragraphs.gist: 侦察蚁把同伴带回旧巢以增加熟悉路线者，既能搬运蚁后与幼蚁又能为守巢者引路，说明群体决策还要靠成员跟随才能落实。

items.en: Certain members can influence the rest of the group to alter a previous decision.
items.zh: 某些成员可以影响小组的其他成员改变先前的决定。

items.en: Individual verification of a proposed choice is important for a successful decision outcome.
items.zh: 要使决策取得好结果，个体应独立核实提议的选项。

items.en: A Study of Insect Decision-making A Bristol University study looked at how insects make decisions when their home has been ________.
items.zh: 布里斯托大学的一项研究考察了昆虫在家园被________之后如何作出决定。
items.why: 与题干“home has been…”时态搭配。文中无“destroyed/ damaged”等更强词，故以threatened 为准。

items.en: The ants in the experiment relied on the use of individuals called ________ to find a new nest and efficiently direct the others to go there.
items.zh: 实验中的蚂蚁依靠被称为________的个体寻找新巢，并有效地引导其他蚂蚁前往。
items.why: 直接同形词填空。唯一恰当名词。

items.en: The study emphasized the necessity, for people as well as insects, of having active ________ in order to execute decisions successfully.
items.zh: 这项研究强调，无论是人还是昆虫，要成功执行决定，都需要积极的________。
items.why: 回到对应内容“不过，这些实验提示我们，即使对人类来说，吸引富有号召力的领导者投身某项事业也很重要，因为集体决策最关键的一点就是能让其他成员跟上”，再按题干要求写出答案。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

pairs: 题干用形容词，定位句改用同词根的副词。
points: 陪审团定理以成员判断正确的概率为起点，推导人数增加时群体选对的机会。
与题干“home has been…”时态搭配。文中无“destroyed/ damaged”等更强词，故以threatened 为准。
clauses: …, the majority decision is more likely to be correct than a decision arrived at by a single juror.
连接词 if 引出“If, for example, each member of a jury has only partial information”，说明主句的条件关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 if 把这一层关系补进去。
Researchers led by Dr List looked at colonies ….
连接词 once 引出“once the original colony reached a certain size”，说明主句的时间关系。
